rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND, Feb 2017)
rules.requirement: Housing providers with DND funding/land or BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units may not use a blanket ban on applicants with arrests or convictions and must review case by case. They may not consider non-conviction arrests, convictions with judicial relief, juvenile records, or convictions over 5 years old (except where there is a direct relationship to the housing or unreasonable risk to others). They may not use credit scores to approve or deny applications.
rules.key_value: No blanket criminal-history bans; no arrests without conviction, juvenile records, or convictions >5 years old; no credit scores
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND, Feb. 2017)
citation_aliases: Boston Department of Neighborhood Development Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.quoted_span: will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions. Housing providers will consider applicants on a case-by-case basis.
rules.effective_date_note: Only the February 2017 policy date is given; the exact effective date is not stated.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply where a conviction directly relates to the housing sought or poses unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others, or to current criminal behavior. Federal or state law with conflicting criminal-history requirements preempts it.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies only to housing providers receiving DND funding or land, or with income-restricted units under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy. Also applied to the Office of Fair Housing and Equity Affirmative Marketing Program.
rules.interaction: Federal or state law that imposes a conflicting criminal history requirement preempts this policy.
rules.conflict_note: This is a funding-conditioned policy under which providers 'agree' to its terms, not a general ordinance. It is unclear how it is enforced.

requires_unknown_facts: property receives DND funding or land, or has income-restricted units under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy

parsed.doc_summary: Boston DND Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (Feb 2017). It limits criminal-history and credit-score screening for housing providers that receive DND funding or land, or that have BPDA inclusionary income-restricted units. It is recorded as one screening_restrictions rule.
